input.answer:
I can't tell you whether to buy or keep renting. That depends on your personal finances, how long you plan to stay, and your risk tolerance, and it calls for personal advice, which I don't give. I also didn't pull any price or rent figures for this answer.

If you want to look at the market data yourself, Statistics Canada's New housing price index (table 18-10-0205, monthly, with Toronto among its geographies) is one place to start. The search also returned a table for commercial rents, but that covers office, retail and industrial buildings, not residential rent, so it won't help with a rent-versus-buy comparison. For residential rents, search StatCan's rent-related tables directly.
